Scope: roads and paving, potable water, TSE, sewer, storm water, irrigation and landscaping, electrical (medium voltage, telecom, street lighting) and CCTV networks in Zones A and G, over 18 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 09-Nov-2026 the project is 47.9% complete against 45.9% planned, 2.0% ahead (SPI 1.04). This week it gained 1.13% against 2.25% planned, half of the plan, so the lead narrowed from 3.1% to 2.0%, the fourth weekly drop in a row. Potable water, electrical and road works earned most of the week's man-hours. Road works and the storm, sewer and potable water networks are ahead; procurement, engineering, electrical works and CCTV are behind.

Ahead overall, but the lead keeps shrinking and procurement is still behind. This week's progress (1.13%) was half of the weekly plan (2.25%). Storm water earned 815 of 7,965 planned man-hours, sewer 35 of 2,549 and CCTV none of 1,147. Procurement is at 60.4% against 99.9% planned (SPI 0.61): MV cables (0 of 51,500 m), unit substations, street lighting poles and lighting panels are still not delivered, and the final substation location is still pending between the Client and SEC. The P6 update still finishes the project on 05-Jul-2027 with zero float, but it moved road works, MV works and all network works 7 to 8 days later, and finishing works now have only 0.7 days of float.

The weekly report and the P6 update disagree on four milestone dates, and P6 moved the network, road and MV milestones later again. Mobilisation finished on 05-Feb-2026 in the weekly report but on 06-Apr-2026 in P6. Technical submittals finished on 16-Aug-2026 in the weekly report but on 25-Jul-2026 in P6. The weekly report forecasts the engineering phase to finish on 28-Sep-2026, while P6 keeps it open and moves it to each data date (now 09-Nov-2026). Procurement finishes on 17-Jan-2027 in the weekly report and 12-Jan-2027 in P6. In this week's P6 update road works moved 8 days later, to 21 days after their baseline (float 7 days, from 12); all network works moved 8 days later, now 1 day after their baseline (float 47 days, from 54); MV works moved 7 days later, to 42 days after their baseline (float 21 days, from 25); finishing works moved to 05-Jul-2027 (float 0.7 days, from 2.7). Project finish has no float left.

Data notes

  • The uploaded files name the project "Phase Two – Part Two" (SUD1-02-011), while the repository folder and the project tracker call it Phase 3 (المرحلة الثالثة).
  • The summary sheet labels cost-based progress as "Plan" and "Actual". This report uses physical progress (man-hour weighted) only: 45.89% planned and 47.87% actual.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet's baseline plans 52.5% at 06-Nov, well above the 45.89% planned to 09-Nov on the front sheet, and it shows the 09-Nov actual (47.87%) on the 06-Nov point. Measured against that chart baseline the project would be behind plan.
  • The front sheet leaves physical progress for electrical, landscape and CCTV works blank; the man-hours in the Progress sheet were used. Its BOQ values for CCTV Zone A and Zone G read 46,056 and 2 SAR instead of 6,513,996 and 2,791,854.
  • The P6 update has the same data date as the weekly report (09-Nov-2026), and its activity counts match the Schedule sheet (823 completed, 351 in progress, 941 not started), but the front sheet still shows 144 in progress.
  • The weekly report puts the procurement phase baseline at 23-Jan-2027; the approved baseline schedule (uploaded with the 19-Oct report) has 21-Nov-2026.
  • The summary page's scope table shows 0 executed for every network, and its totals differ from the hidden Conclusion sheet (for example roads 15,234 m vs 18,252 m). Manholes are labelled "m" in the Major Quantities sheet but are counted in units.
  • Procurement figures disagree: street lighting poles are 590 units and 10% complete in the Procurement sheet but 592 units with 1 delivered in Major Quantities; LV cables are 29,700 m vs 68,400 m. MV cables are "not submitted" in procurement, while the risk register says they have been procured.
  • November planned head count is 391 in the monthly table (365 manual, 26 non-manual) but 390 in the head-count panel (350 manual, 40 non-manual). Cumulative toolbox talks rose from 43 to 58 although only one was held this week.
  • Several cells show #REF! errors (EAC, risk scores, safety score in the status score). The substation risk carries a value of 6,835,460.61 SAR, which is the landscape BOQ value.
  • Several sheets (front sheet header, Major Quantities, Physical-Chart Data) still carry 19-Oct-2026 as their date and the Milestones sheet now carries 09-Oct-2026, although the report's data date is 09-Nov-2026. The Procurement sheet is unchanged from 26-Oct. The report week is the contract week the report states (44 of 78); whole weeks since handover give 43.
